name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 1 - Am 68
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 1a. Condemns in the strongest possible terms the exploitation of rule-of-law conditionality for the purpose of politically motivated ideological attacks against Member States; emphasises that, as part of these attacks, the Commission has clearly used and funded left-wing NGOs and media outlets with Union funds; therefore demands an immediate end to the use of Union funds to finance these attacks on national sovereignty, which are perpetrated through the misuse of rule-of-law conditionality;
